summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Ricardo ZapDelivery admin panel. All core admin functionality working correctly including authentication, dashboard statistics, product CRUD operations, and mobile responsiveness.

flaky_endpoints.issue: Returns 403 instead of expected 401 for unauthorized access

ui_bugs.issue: No visible error message displayed for invalid credentials (401 response received but not shown to user)

passed_tests: Admin login with valid credentials (admin/admin123)
JWT token generation and storage in localStorage
Redirect to dashboard after successful login
Dashboard statistics display (Total: 29, Hambúrgueres: 18, Acompanhamentos: 6, Bebidas: 6, Sobremesas: 4)
Product grid display with images, names, descriptions, and prices
Category filter buttons functionality
Novo Produto button and modal opening
Product creation form with all fields (name, description, price, category, image URL)
Image preview functionality in product form
Edit product modal opening with pre-filled data
Product deletion with confirmation dialog
Logout functionality and redirect to login page
Ver Site button redirect to homepage
Mobile responsiveness - header, buttons, and modal adapt correctly
Mobile modal fits within viewport (390px)
Backend API /api/auth/login (valid and invalid credentials)
Backend API /api/admin/products (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE)
Backend API /api/admin/stats returning correct product counts
JWT token authentication for protected routes
Product CRUD operations via admin endpoints
Category filtering in admin dashboard
action_item_for_main_agent: Minor fix needed: Add visible error message display for invalid login credentials on the frontend. Currently the 401 response is received but no error message is shown to the user.
